item.title: Arkansas State Police traffic stop leads to cocaine seizure, federal charges, prison for Dominican man
item.description: A 60-year-old man from the Dominican Republic was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison for possession with intent to distribute cocaine after being pulled over by Arkansas State Police in 2024.

item.title: Arkansas Martin Luther King Jr. Commission leading Selma Bridge Crossing Jubilee
item.description: A delegation from the Arkansas Martin Luther King Jr. Commission will travel to Selma, Alabama on March 7 & 8 to commemorate the 1965 "Bloody Sunday" event, which galvanized support for the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

item.title: North Little Rock Airshow returning for 2026, tickets on sale next week
item.description: The North Little Rock Airshow will take place on October 3 and 4, featuring aerobatic maneuvers, family fun, kids' zones, food trucks, and displays of historic warbirds and modern marvels.

item.title: North Little Rock neighbors concerned over deadly shooting on North Magnolia Street
item.description: Police in North Little Rock are investigating after a man was found dead following a shooting early Friday morning.

item.title: Power tool batteries possibly behind Conway County house fire
item.description: A Conway County couple is safe after an early morning fire Friday that heavily damaged their home on Petit Jean Mountain, one that the fire department believes may have started from charging power tool batteries.

item.title: Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders awards posthumous Arkansas Medal of Freedom to Navy SEAL Adam Brown
item.description: Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders invited the family of Chief Petty Officer Adam Brown to the Governor’s Mansion to honor him, posthumously, with the Arkansas Medal of Freedom. Brown was a U.S. Navy SEAL who gave his life for his country.

item.title: DNA leads to cold case rape trial, life sentence, in Conway
item.description: An unsolved 2004 rape was brought to court after DNA identified a suspect.

item.title: Alexis Ray Parker on vulnerability in songwriting, mental health & getting spark for new music | Arkansas Soul Sessions
item.description: Alexis Ray Parker joined in on a session with Miriam B. to talk about openness in her songwriting throughout her projects, her experiences with mental health and new music coming this year.

item.title: Arkansas cat lost during winter storm found a year later miles away
item.description: A senior Siamese cat named June that disappeared from its Arkansas home during a winter storm last year was reunited with its family this week thanks to a microchip.
